name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; no Ghidra address residue. 'slide_panel' domain, 'down_step' descriptor pairs it with the sibling fd2_slide_panel_up_partial_step @0x1839B. Descriptor 'down' reflects the chapter-portrait slide-down entrance it was authored for; the function is structurally the full-frame variant (owns bg restore + VGA flush) vs the sibling's partial copy. Name accurately reflects purpose and internal logic.
purpose: Render one full frame of the chapter-portrait dialog-panel slide animation: restore background, blit the dialog panel rows at a caller-supplied Y, and flush the whole frame to VGA.
logic_summary: memmove restores dst_workspace from the clean background snapshot (data_fd2_ui_slide_bg_snapshot_buf, 64000B = full 320x200 frame). row_count starts at 0x56 (86), clipped to (200 - y_offset) when y_offset+0x56 would pass screen row 200. Loop copies row_count rows of 0x136 (310) bytes from src_buffer+0x8C05 (composed dialog buffer interior at y=0x70, x=5: 0x70*0x140+5) into dst_workspace at (y_offset+row)*0x140 + 5. Final memmove blits the whole 64000B workspace to mode-13h VRAM at 0xA0000. Direction-agnostic: callers drive y_offset per frame (slide-in y descends toward 0x70, slide-out y ascends off-screen). __CHK(0x1c) is the Watcom stack-probe prologue, not source.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_slide_panel_down_step(uint32 y_offset, uint32 dst_workspace, uint32 src_buffer)

params.name: y_offset
params.semantics: Top screen row (mode-13h Y) at which the dialog panel is drawn this frame. Callers compute it as frame_iter*0xD + 0x70: slide-in frame 5->0 makes y descend toward the rest position 0x70; slide-out frame 1->5 makes y ascend so the panel slides down off-screen. Used both for row-count bottom clipping and as the destination row base.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches usage (vertical screen-row offset of the panel), no address residue.

params.name: dst_workspace
params.semantics: Destination render workspace (the slide accumulator buffer data_fd2_ui_slide_anim_accumulator_buf). Background snapshot is restored into it, panel rows are composited onto it, then the whole buffer is blitted to VGA.
params.reason: Descriptive and accurate (the per-frame render scratch buffer); no address residue.

params.name: src_buffer
params.semantics: Source composed-dialog buffer (data_fd2_ui_slide_composed_target_buf) holding the pre-rendered dialog frame + portrait. Panel rows are read from src_buffer+0x8C05 (interior at y=0x70, x=5).
params.reason: Descriptive and accurate (the source image for the panel rows); no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effect: dst_workspace fully repainted and the resulting frame copied to mode-13h VRAM (0xA0000).

comment_original_issue: Existing src comment was accurate but minimal (single line 'Restore background, copy panel rows, blit to VGA.'): it omitted the parameter meaning, the bottom-row clipping, the panel geometry (0x56 rows of 310B from +0x8C05), the direction-agnostic per-frame y_offset driving, and the full-frame vs partial-sibling distinction.
